certification.note: absolute_error is E_var measured against an INDEPENDENT near-exact DMRG-extrapolated reference (not the self-consistent PT2 estimate). As box A grows, E_var descends and this gap closes; reported as-measured against whichever E_var is committed at read time.

honest_caveats: DMRG-extrapolated FCI is an estimate with a fit uncertainty (reported), not a rigorous two-sided bracket like E_var+PT2; standard practice (SHCI/DMRG literature) but stated as such.

Supplementary and independent — box A's pre-registered E3 PT2 certificate is the primary route and is reported unchanged whatever its terminal (convergence / OOM / deadline).
